exploitability: Requires invocation of toBigIntLE with oversized data; this bootstrap package is an operator-run Localnet tool, not a hosted endpoint.
exposure: tools/bootstrap only; release CI executes it against generated Localnet fixtures. Untrusted inputs remain a residual risk.
mitigation: No Mainnet deployment path; controlled Localnet fixtures; fail on any new high advisory. Replace dependency when a compatible patched SPL SDK is available.
